summary.text: Kathy Szeliga is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 7A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She and fellow incumbent Ryan Nawrocki face Democrats Lydia Xinzhen Brown and Satish Chapagain for the district's two seats.
A small business owner and former teacher, she serves on the Health Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Kathy Szeliga was born in Baltimore and earned a B.A. in elementary education, summa cum laude, from Towson State University in 1994.
According to her legislative biography, she has owned a construction contracting business since 1986, worked as a teacher and been a foster parent.
She was chief of staff to Senator Andrew P. Harris from 2004 to 2010, according to the biography.
Ballotpedia lists Szeliga's tenure in the House as beginning in 2011 and says her current term began on January 11, 2023.
The General Assembly website lists her as a member of the Health Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
